definition: Andrew Fitzgibbon (born 1968) is an Irish researcher in computer vision.
details: Since 2022, he has worked at Graphcore.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Andrew Fitzgibbon (engineer) — giving a machine the gift of sight.
